verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a Kubernetes-based control-plane framework, so the axis applies. The pack only shows adjacent features: alpha/beta feature flags, Composition Revisions for managing Composition changes, and CLI version selection. None of these documents versioned API stability guarantees or a deprecation policy, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
